summary: Implemented the file-reading progress feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (module-level open and wrap_file, private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added entry linking PR 1759). Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and any repository code were not run; all checks were by reading. Choices to review: cast(Any, mode) in the module-level open instead of a suppression; return-value and type-var suppressions omitted; Progress.open creates the task before opening the file, so an explicit-total call on a missing path leaves a task behind.
